name: wake-skills
description: Wake's personal skill collection: article evaluation and README writing skills for ZCode.

description_i18n.en: Wake's personal skill collection: article evaluation and README writing skills for ZCode.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Wake 的个人技能合集：文章价值评估与 README 撰写技能。

plugins.name: article-valuator
plugins.description: Evaluate whether an article is worth reading: fetches the page (or takes pasted text), scores depth, actionability, novelty and relevance, then returns a 10-point verdict with evidence.

description_i18n.en: Evaluate whether an article is worth reading: fetches the page (or takes pasted text), scores depth, actionability, novelty and relevance, then returns a 10-point verdict with evidence.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 评估文章值不值得读：抓取链接正文（或分析粘贴文本），按深度、可操作性、新颖度、相关性四维打分，给出 10 分制结论与理由。

plugins.name: readme-craft
plugins.description: Generate a standardized, human-sounding, GFM-compliant README.md, using AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md as extra context when present.

description_i18n.en: Generate a standardized, human-sounding, GFM-compliant README.md, using AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md as extra context when present.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 生成标准化、语气人性化、符合 GFM 规范的 README.md，可读取 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 作为补充上下文。
